station_discrepancy_policy.policy_description: Person C ML strictly uses 'MTR' and 'BRT'. Any legacy 'BHR' identifier from Person A backend is rejected with a descriptive ValueError. Person A must normalize 'BHR' -> 'BRT' before passing telemetry to the adapter.

temporal_requirements.continuity_rule: The 24 records must be strictly contiguous hourly observations without gaps. Any gap > 3600s resets the contiguous lookback window.

status.description: Indicates whether 24 contiguous hourly records were available to execute unified prediction

latest_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the most recently ingested record

available_history.description: Number of valid contiguous hourly records currently in the sliding buffer

required_history.description: Required lookback window size for multi-horizon neural forecasting

prediction.description: Nested UnifiedEnergyPrediction dictionary matching energy_ml_inference_contract.json when status is PREDICTION_AVAILABLE; null when INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY

insufficient_history.message: Buffering in progress: 6/24 contiguous hourly records.

provenance.calibration_reference: Australian Antarctic Data Centre (AADC CC BY 4.0) & NCPOR Meteorological Archives
provenance.disclaimer: Validated on synthetic Polarix operational microgrid telemetry. Not validated on real classified station SCADA telemetry.
